lines.trans: We are broadcasting our report from Krasnoarmeyskaya Street.
Candidate Ivan Samsonov came out into the courtyard. Today he paved over an old pothole himself!
The road service promised to pave it over ten years ago.
Ivan, your rivals hold meetings and make promises.
And today you paved a pothole in a courtyard. Aren't you wasting your time in vain?
What is the point of chattering? Everyone talks, and I act!
Stop, that's a wrap! Good job, Samson!
Hey, I almost broke my car right here!
You laid it unevenly over there! Now there will be a little puddle there!
A little puddle?! I will level out that puddle with you right now! Understood?
I am not going to vote for you! I am leaving here!
Well, I will! So, Ilona, what is next?
All right, the workers can take their roller back.
Everything is great, get some rest! It is the weekend today, everything is cool!

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to chatter, chat, talk idly', paired with 'поболтать'.

examples.text: Не словом, а делом! Все болтают, а я работаю.
examples.trans: Not in word, but in deed! Everyone chatters, while I work.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: Formed with a diminutive/expressive Slavic suffix adding warmth or small scale. Common masculine noun meaning 'roller' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: The workers can take their roller back.
He painted the wall with a roller.

examples.text: Ну всё, рабочие могут забирать свой валик.
examples.trans: All right, the workers can take their roller back.
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?

вести.gloss: to lead, to conduct (вести себя = to behave)

meanings.en: to lead, to guide, to drive
вести себя: to behave, to conduct oneself
meanings.note: Вы как маленькая себя ведёте = You're behaving like a little girl

examples.trans: You're behaving like a little girl.

examples.text: Лидия Алексеевна, успокойтесь, пожалуйста! Вы как маленькая себя ведёте.
examples.trans: Lydia Alexeyevna, calm down, please! You're behaving like a little girl.

meanings.note: pointing at something a little way off
вон отсюда! = get out of here!

examples.trans: All right, here you go. There, look.

examples.text: Я и сама хорошо проведу время.
examples.trans: I'll have a good time on my own.

meanings.note: after a plural noun or pronoun: вы все

examples.text: И знаешь, что самое главное? Всем всё равно.
examples.trans: And you know the main thing? Nobody cares.

examples.text: Решается ваш вопрос, Клавдия Викторовна! Вы не видите, у меня встреча?
examples.trans: Your question is being sorted out, Klavdia Viktorovna! Can't you see I have a meeting?

meanings.note: ends a conversation or an order: 'Всё, свободен' = that's all, you can go
at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

выйти.gloss: to go out, to get out

meanings.note: Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to go out, to get out', paired with 'выходить'.

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks.

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели. Я решу все ваши проблемы.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks. I'll solve all your problems.

meanings.note: substantivized adjective, declines like an adjective

examples.trans: It is the weekend today, everything is cool!

examples.text: Всё отлично, отдыхай! Сегодня выходные, всё круто!
examples.trans: Everything is great, get some rest! It is the weekend today, everything is cool!

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: Я тебе говорю = I'm telling you
after 2, 3, 4: года; after 5 and more: лет

examples.trans: I've been working here for four years.

examples.text: Это было давно, тридцать лет назад.
examples.trans: That was long ago, thirty years back.

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been working as mayor for four years now.

examples.text: Я за тебя голосовать не буду!
examples.trans: I am not going to vote for you!
All the neighbours voted in the election.

examples.text: Я за тебя голосовать не буду! Ухожу отсюда!
examples.trans: I am not going to vote for you! I am leaving here!

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

meanings.note: in a list or a story
in a list or a story

examples.text: А дальше? Я очень волнуюсь, я к этому не приспособлена.
examples.trans: And then what? I'm very nervous, I'm not cut out for this.

meanings.note: во дворе = in the yard / outside

examples.trans: The children are playing in the yard.
At the same time I'll trim the branches in the yard.

examples.text: Вы пенсионерке помогли и двор наш очистили.
examples.trans: You helped a pensioner and cleared our yard.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to do, to make', paired with 'сделать'.

examples.trans: Hi, Arkady Borisovich. What are you doing?

meanings.note: followed by the genitive plural: 'десять минут'

examples.text: Ладно, будь там. Через десять минут буду.
examples.trans: All right, stay there. I'll be there in ten minutes.

examples.text: Дорожная служба обещала закатать её десять лет назад.
examples.trans: The road service promised to pave it over ten years ago.
The driver looked at the road sign.

meanings.note: забирать деньги = to take the money
забирать детей из школы = to pick the kids up from school

examples.trans: I pick the children up from school.

examples.text: А я тебе делаю условный срок. Плюс ты забираешь все деньги Вики.
examples.trans: And I get you a suspended sentence. Plus you take all of Vika's money.

meanings.en: to roll flat, pave over (a pothole, asphalt)

examples.text: Он сегодня сам закатал старую яму!
examples.trans: Today he paved over an old pothole himself!

examples.text: А вы сегодня закатали яму во дворе.
examples.trans: And today you paved a pothole in a courtyard.

examples.text: Кандидат Иван Самсонов вышел во двор. Он сегодня сам закатал старую яму!
examples.trans: Candidate Ivan Samsonov came out into the courtyard. Today he paved over an old pothole himself!

meanings.en: to level out, make even, fill and smooth over

examples.text: Я тобой сейчас эту лужицу заровняю!
examples.trans: I will level out that puddle with you right now!
The workers leveled out the hole in the courtyard.

examples.text: Лужица?! Я тобой сейчас эту лужицу заровняю! Понял?
examples.trans: A little puddle?! I will level out that puddle with you right now! Understood?

meanings.note: Зря ты так = You shouldn't have
Зря ты так = You shouldn't have

examples.text: Вы зря теряете время. Шпионить для вас я не буду.
examples.trans: You're wasting your time. I'm not going to spy for you.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: in an election or for a job

examples.trans: He is a candidate for mayor.

meanings.note: in business, sport or an election

examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?
It is the weekend today, everything is cool!

examples.text: Всё отлично, отдыхай! Сегодня выходные, всё круто!
examples.trans: Everything is great, get some rest! It is the weekend today, everything is cool!

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'little puddle' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: Now there will be a little puddle there!
A small puddle glistened on the asphalt.

examples.text: Ты вон там неровно положил! Там теперь лужица будет!
examples.trans: You laid it unevenly over there! Now there will be a little puddle there!

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'car; machine' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: Which car did you come in?

meanings.note: praise, said to a man, woman or child

examples.trans: I see, I see, you're a hero. Well done.

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

meanings.note: два года назад = two years ago

examples.text: Я их ещё два года назад им выделил!
examples.trans: I allocated it to them two years ago!

examples.text: Я их ещё два года назад им выделил! Я сам приказ подписывал!
examples.trans: I allocated it to them two years ago! I signed the order myself!

meanings.note: наш, наша, наше, наши; agrees with the noun

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: You laid it unevenly over there!

examples.text: Ты вон там неровно положил! Там теперь лужица будет!
examples.trans: You laid it unevenly over there! Now there will be a little puddle there!

meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

meanings.note: дать / выполнить обещание = make / fulfil a promise

examples.text: Подождите, Клавдия Викторовна. Мы же выполнили свои обещания.
examples.trans: Wait, Klavdia Viktorovna. We fulfilled our promises.

meanings.note: + dative of the person: обещать вам

examples.text: Марина, я вам обещаю: со стеной ничего не случится.
examples.trans: Marina, I promise you: nothing will happen to the wall.

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.text: Паша, я больше не хочу о ней слышать. Понял?
examples.trans: Pasha, I don't want to hear about her again. Understood?

meanings.en: to rest, relax, be on holiday

examples.trans: Everything is great, get some rest!
In the summer we vacation by the sea.

examples.text: Всё отлично, отдыхай! Сегодня выходные, всё круто!
examples.trans: Everything is great, get some rest! It is the weekend today, everything is cool!

meanings.note: used as an exclamation of approval

examples.trans: I know this town really well!

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели. Я решу все ваши проблемы.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks. I'll solve all your problems.

meanings.en: to put, to place, to lay down

examples.text: В гроб с собой икру не положишь!
examples.trans: You can't put caviar in your coffin to take with you!
Put the keys on the table.

examples.text: А вот сюда я её и положу! Отличный подарок будет!
examples.trans: Right here is where I will put it! It will be an excellent gift!

meanings.note: понял? = got it?; понял = got it

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

проводить.gloss: to see off, to see out

meanings.en: to see someone out, to see off
meanings.note: accompany someone to the door or the station
a different, imperfective verb проводить means 'to conduct, to spend (time)'

examples.text: Держи свои духи. Давай я тебя провожу. Пока!
examples.trans: Here is your perfume. Let me walk you out. Bye!

examples.text: Мы построим кластер. Это тысячи рабочих мест.
examples.trans: We will build the cluster. That means thousands of jobs.

meanings.note: вести репортаж = to broadcast a report

examples.text: Мы ведём наш репортаж с улицы Красноармейской.
examples.trans: We are broadcasting our report from Krasnoarmeyskaya Street.
In the evening they showed a report about the election.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

examples.text: Я и сама хорошо проведу время.
examples.trans: I'll have a good time on my own.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.text: А что я за мэр такой, который держит своё слово?
examples.trans: And what kind of mayor would I be if I kept my word?

examples.text: Виктор Степанович, сегодня никак не могу.
examples.trans: Viktor Stepanovich, I really can't today.

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.note: сломать руку = to break one's arm

examples.text: Меня жена бросила. Два пальца сломаны.
examples.trans: My wife has left me. Two of my fingers are broken.

examples.text: Дорожная служба обещала закатать её десять лет назад.
examples.trans: The road service promised to pave it over ten years ago.
Right now we need to call social services.

снять.gloss: to film, to photograph; to take off; to rent

meanings.en: to film, to take a photo/video of

examples.text: Я сняла пьяного соседа на телефон.
examples.trans: I filmed a drunk neighbour on my phone.
He took off his coat by the door.

examples.text: Я сняла пьяного соседа на телефон. И сразу все мне помогают!
examples.trans: I filmed a drunk neighbour on my phone. And right away everyone helps me!

examples.text: Славик, смотри сюда. Меняю свой новый айфон на твой старый телефон.
examples.trans: Slavik, look here. I'll swap my new iPhone for your old phone.

meanings.note: Core Russian interj meaning 'stop!, cut!' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: Stop, you cannot go any further!
Stop, that's a wrap! Good job, Samson!

meanings.note: там такие деньги = there's so much money in it

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

examples.text: Теперь я начальник нашей стройки. Ты уволен!
examples.trans: Now I'm the boss of our building site. You're fired!

meanings.note: + acc; зря тратить время = to waste time in vain

examples.trans: Aren't you wasting your time in vain?

examples.text: А вы сегодня закатали яму во дворе. Вы не зря тратите время?
examples.trans: And today you paved a pothole in a courtyard. Aren't you wasting your time in vain?
There's someone here to see you.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, I'm sorry, there's a man here to see you.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: на улице = out on the street / outside
на улице холодно = it's cold outside

examples.text: На Московской улице перевернули ящики с мусором.
examples.trans: On Moskovskaya Street someone tipped over the rubbish bins.
There are reporters out on the street!

meanings.en: to leave, to go away (on foot)

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: чуть не + verb: я чуть не упал = I nearly fell

examples.text: Садись, не бойся. Я ведь сам чуть тебя не отпустил.
examples.trans: Sit down, don't be afraid. I very nearly let you go myself.

examples.text: Хорошая, никто же не говорит. Эй, ты что?
examples.trans: She is good, nobody's saying she isn't. Hey, what's wrong?

meanings.note: alone: 'я этого не хочу' = I don't want that

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
pit, hole in the ground; pothole in a road
meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'pit, pothole, hole' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: А вы сегодня закатали яму во дворе.
examples.trans: And today you paved a pothole in a courtyard.
There was a deep pothole in the road.

examples.text: Кандидат Иван Самсонов вышел во двор. Он сегодня сам закатал старую яму!
examples.trans: Candidate Ivan Samsonov came out into the courtyard. Today he paved over an old pothole himself!
